title: radio recovery: reconnect, then the next station (manual until automated)

clauses.text: When a live station drops, the sound already on its way plays out and the same station is retried (status: Reconnecting 1 of 2).

steps.do: Play a live station, then drop the network for about five seconds (turn the Wi-Fi off and on, or unplug the cable).
steps.expect: The sound already on its way plays out, the status line says Reconnecting 1 of 2, and when the station comes back it plays on.

clauses.text: When the retries fail, the radio goes on to the next station of your list (status: Switched to NAME).

steps.do: Have two stations in My stations. Play the first, then keep the network off until the retries are used up.
steps.expect: The status line says Switched to the second station's name, and the second station plays.

clauses.text: After one full pass without success, the radio stops and says so in plain words.

steps.do: With the network still off, let the radio go through the whole list.
steps.expect: It stops and shows a plain message. It does not loop forever.

clauses.text: Settings, Radio sets the reconnect tries (0 to 5, two by default) and the next-station switch (on by default).

steps.do: Open Settings, Radio and read Reconnect tries and Go on to the next station. Change them, leave, and come back.
steps.expect: Reconnect tries shows 2 and Go on to the next station is on by default. The changes are kept.
